nodes.d: A hit taken from a creature reflects 20% of what landed (and your Reflect Damage once more) as physical damage, at most 50% of your maximum health a hit. Players take a third (at most 5% of their health a hit), bosses half (at most 2 x your level a second). Your damage is 10% less.

A critical hit releases a burst on the other enemies within 1 sqm of its target for 60% of the hit, of your strongest tree element (energy if none), at most once every 0.8 s. Your non-critical hits deal 5% less.
Every hit you deal leeches 5% of its damage as health, at most 6% of your maximum health in any second. Healing you receive is 30% less.
Ranger line: bow and crossbow hits arc to 3 other enemies within 3 sqm for 40% of the hit as energy damage. The hit on its own target deals 10% less.

nodes.d: Ranger and Thief lines: 2 more traps and 3 more mines may be out at once; they arm in 50% of the time and hit 25% harder. Your other hits (weapon, spells; not damage over time) are 15% less.

Mystic and Templar lines: fire and holy spell hits ignite (15% of the hit over 4 s). A spell that hits one enemy brands it for 8 s: every second the sigil burns enemies within 1 sqm for 5% of that hit and jumps on when its bearer dies; ignited monsters spread the burn to 2 more when they die. Damage that is not fire or holy is 20% less.
Thief line: a monster that dies with your poison on it spreads it to 3 monsters within 2 sqm (5 ticks of its last tick). Spread poison spreads again, up to 4 deep. Your weapon hits deal 10% less.

Warrior and Templar lines. Out of a protection zone and in a fight, enemies within 2 sqm take 4% of your maximum health as fire damage every second. You burn for 2.5% of your maximum health a second (never lethal; your fire absorbs count) and regenerate 2% of it a second. Your other damage is 25% less.
Every line but the Monk's. With no weapon in your hands (a shield is fine) your fists hit with the Monk's fist attack (40 + level / 40, at most 60) and your best melee skill, +10% damage.

beastmaster.d: Bow and crossbow hits: 100% chance to ricochet to the nearest other enemy within 4 sqm for 65% of the hit, then once more for 65% of that (42%). Never the same target twice.

berserker.d: Two-handed melee hits cleave: up to 3 other enemies next to you take 40% of the hit.

bonelord.d: A monster you or your minions kill explodes: 12% of its maximum health (at most 15 x your level) as death damage on up to 6 enemies within 2 sqm. Your and your minions' hits deal 8% less.

deadeye.d: Bow and crossbow hits on the same target deal +4% more each, up to +20%. Another target (or 6 s without a hit) starts again.

illusionist.d: Support (needs a party): your hits mark the enemy for 6 s. Other party members deal +12% damage to a marked enemy and heal for 4% of it.

inquisitor.d: With a shield: 20% chance to block a melee or ranged attack completely. A block sends a holy nova (once per 1 s): up to 8 enemies within 2 sqm take the blocked hit + 4 x your magic level. Your weapon hits deal 10% less.

ironsage.d: Heals you cast on others also plant regrowth: 10% of the heal again over 6 s (3 pulses). A new heal adds its share to what is left.

juggernaut.d: You take 8% less damage, 16% less while below 50% health.

knight.d: Two-handed melee hits cleave: up to 3 other enemies next to you take 40% of the hit.

lich.d: A monster you or your minions kill explodes: 12% of its maximum health (at most 15 x your level) as death damage on up to 6 enemies within 2 sqm. Your and your minions' hits deal 8% less.

monk.d: Every 5th melee hit (fists or weapon) within 4 s is a finisher: 120% more damage, and a shockwave hits up to 4 enemies next to the target for 50% of it. Your other melee hits deal 10% less.

necromancer.d: A monster you or your minions kill explodes: 12% of its maximum health (at most 15 x your level) as death damage on up to 6 enemies within 2 sqm. Your and your minions' hits deal 8% less.

ninja.d: Weapon hits: 30% chance for your shadow to strike the same target again 0.3 s later for 60% of the hit. You take 6% more damage.

paladin.d: Bow and crossbow hits: 100% chance to ricochet to the nearest other enemy within 4 sqm for 65% of the hit, then once more for 65% of that (42%). Never the same target twice.

samurai.d: Weapon hits: 30% chance for your shadow to strike the same target again 0.3 s later for 60% of the hit. You take 6% more damage.

sentinel.d: With a shield: 20% chance to block a melee or ranged attack completely. A block sends a holy nova (once per 1 s): up to 8 enemies within 2 sqm take the blocked hit + 4 x your magic level. Your weapon hits deal 10% less.

shadowfist.d: Every 5th melee hit (fists or weapon) within 4 s is a finisher: 120% more damage, and a shockwave hits up to 4 enemies next to the target for 50% of it. Your other melee hits deal 10% less.

sorcerer.d: Spells that hit 2 or more enemies: 35% chance to echo 0.6 s later on the same spots for 50% of their damage. Cooldown 3 s.

templar.d: With a shield: 20% chance to block a melee or ranged attack completely. A block sends a holy nova (once per 1 s): up to 8 enemies within 2 sqm take the blocked hit + 4 x your magic level. Your weapon hits deal 10% less.
